basis.saw: Three-circle Venn diagram with labelled sectors; left panel of Figure 1.

narrative.text: Figure 1 (left): Venn diagram of three overlapping circles around the centre text 'Public Health LLM Evaluations': Burden (Diseases, Symptoms, Injuries) [5], Risk Factors (Environment, Behaviour, Biology) [5], and Interventions (Non-Pharmaceutical, Pharmaceutical) [6].

basis.saw: Radar chart with radial scale 0-1 and model legend; right panel of Figure 1.

narrative.text: Figure 1 (right): radar chart of micro-F1 scores (radial axis 0 to 1) on 16 tasks prefixed B- (burden), RF- (risk factors) and I- (interventions), for seven models: Command-R-0824-32B, Flan-T5-xxl, Gemma-2-27B-It, Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2, Mistral-Large-AWQ4Bit, Stable-Beluga-2. Most models score near 0.8-0.95 on B-News Headline and B-GI Classification and lower on I-Causal Relations and I-BioDex Drugs Extraction.

basis.saw: Three coloured header boxes with numbered task lists; Figure 2.

narrative.text: Figure 2: evaluation tasks by public health area, in three columns. Burden: NCBI Disease Extract., Gastro. Illness Class., Gastro. Illness Symptom Extract., ICD-10 Description Class., News Headline Class. Risk Factors: Contact Type Class., Country Disambiguation, Food Extract., MMLU Genetics, MMLU Nutrition. Interventions: Guidance Topic Class., Guidance Recommendation Class., Health Advice Class., Health Causal Claims Class., BioDex Drugs Extract., PubMedQA Reasoning.

basis.saw: Grouped bar chart with axes and legend; Figure 3.

narrative.text: Figure 3, 'Contact Classification with Zero and Few Shot Prompting': micro F1-score (0 to ~0.8) for 11 models, A-Zero-Shot (blue) vs B-Few-Shot (orange). Few-shot exceeds zero-shot for every model except Llama-3.1 8B (about 0.26 vs 0.14); Stable Beluga-2 has the highest few-shot score, about 0.79.

basis.saw: Grouped bar chart with axes and legend; Figure 4.

narrative.text: Figure 4, 'Causal Relations Classification with Zero and Few Shot Prompting': micro F1-score (0 to ~0.7) for 11 models, zero-shot (blue) vs few-shot (orange). Few-shot is higher for all models except Flan-T5 xxl (about 0.50 vs 0.48); Llama-3.3 70B is highest, about 0.62 zero-shot and 0.69 few-shot.

basis.saw: Three-circle chain diagram with a spectrum line; Figure 5.

narrative.text: Figure 5, LLM evaluation spectrum: three chained circles, General Evaluations (e.g. Languages, Reasoning, Maths), Domain Evaluations (e.g. Medicine, Law, Finance) and Task Specific Evaluations (e.g. Classify x, Extract y, Summarise z), with the domain-task overlap marked by an asterisk. A line beneath runs from 'Foundation Model' to 'Production Deployment'.

basis.saw: Grid diagram with row/column header boxes and a colour legend; Figure 6.

narrative.text: Figure 6, overview of evaluations: a grid with columns Automated, Human and LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluations and rows General, Domain Specific and Task Specific Evaluations. The General row is greyed 'Out of Scope'; the automated domain and task cells are green ('This Paper'); the remaining cells are peach ('Future Public Health AI Research').
